reason: Holds on the 65SC12. TAY/TYA/PHX/PLX and SBC # are all real 65SC12 opcodes; no decimal mode. Recount: removed STA zp (85 48, 3c/2B), LDA zp (A5 48, 3c/2B), SEC (2c/1B); added TAY, TYA (2c/1B each); SBC #8 -> SBC #7 same size and time: -4 cycles and -3 bytes each time a part is drawn. C = 0 after the high ADC: save_start + a part offset inside an arena block (&35xx-&3Fxx) never carries out of 16 bits, so CLC-style SBC #7 = SEC; SBC #8 with the same borrow out. Y is not an input to columns (its RTS path never reads Y, its other path does LDY #10), and every later user reloads Y from rb_index. rb_p8 (&47-&48 in ren_zp) is named nowhere else in src/ and no other label sits at &48, so the stale byte is unread. Layout (listing): BEQ no_part (&9DD0, target &9DFD -> &9DFA) stays in page &9D; BPL each_part moves &9DFF -> &9DFC, next PC &9DFE, so it stops crossing to &9DCC (-1 cycle a taken branch, as claimed). Everything else in DATA1 after &9E01 shifts by -3 (no ALIGN before &B37D). Scan of every branch in the shifted region: one starts crossing that the candidate did not count, record_differs' first BNE out (&9FFE -> &9FFB, next PC &9FFD, target &A02B): +1 cycle only when a record's type differs from the live slot's (new, changed or dying movers: rare), so it does not cancel the saving. All other branches unchanged. No indexed table read in the shifted region has a base low byte < 3, so the shift only reduces or keeps page crossings on indexed reads. No self-modified operand in the changed lines. Minor: relies_on says columns moves to &9E16; it is &9E17 (a 3-byte shift).
